# Kernellum

> Kernellum is building an AI-native model-to-hardware compiler for workload-specific accelerators.

Kernellum Compiler maps supported neural workloads and deployment constraints into an explicit hardware IR, searches candidate accelerator architectures, emits inspectable SystemVerilog RTL, and generates verification evidence.

Current status: research-stage prototype. Physical FPGA place-and-route, measured latency and measured power remain pending and are not claimed.

## Demonstrated evidence
- 96.22% float held-out accuracy
- 96.44% INT8 held-out accuracy
- 99.78% float/INT8 prediction agreement
- 450/450 cycle-model / vector-INT8 agreement
- 32/32 RTL golden-vector simulation PASS
- generic Yosys synthesis PASS with 0 CHECK problems
- ECP5 family mapping: 7,977 LUT4 and 8 MULT18X18D

The 680-cycle / 6.8 µs figure is modeled at an assumed 100 MHz clock, not a measured physical-hardware result.
